p: considereth the poor: Not condemning him as accused whom God visits, knowing that there are various reasons why God lays his hand on us, yea and afterwards he restores us.
bed of languishing: When for sorrow and grief of mind he calls himself on his bed.
bed in his sickness: You have restored him in his sick bed and sent him comfort.
speak evil of me: That is, curse me and cannot have their cruel hate quenched but with my shameful death.
vanity: For pretending to comfort me, he conspires my death in his heart, and brags of it.
An evil disease: The enemies thought by his sharp punishments that God had become his mortal enemy.
hath lifted up his heel against: As David felt this falsehood, and as it was chiefly accomplished in Christ, Joh 13:18 so shall his members continually prove the same.
in mine integrity: Meaning, either in prosperity of life or in the true fear of God against all temptation.
face for ever: Showing me evident signs of your fatherly providence.
Amen: By this repetition he stirs up the faithful to praise God.
